finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

**1. Ticket created — DONE.** Ticket `RD-1015` titled "fwrd63-n1 RD Bench Ticket" exists (customer "Bench Test Co", raised 2026-09-16, initial status Draft).

**2. Part A — DONE.** Part "fwrd63-n1 RD Part A" with cost 100 and markup 25. App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 + 25% markup), quantity 1, supplier Bench Supplies Ltd.

**3. Part B — DONE.** Part "fwrd63-n1 RD Part B" with cost 200 and markup 25. App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 + 25% markup), quantity 1, supplier Bench Supplies Ltd. Ticket Total at that point: $375.00.

**4. Part A cost changed to 150 — DONE.** After the edit, Part A's row read $150.00 / 25% / 1 / Bench Supplies Ltd, and the app-computed price was **$187.50** (150 + 25%). Ticket Total became $437.50.

**5. Status Ready — DONE.** The ticket's status is **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **a ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready.** On our ticket the "Mark Ready" action was accepted immediately (the precondition was already satisfied by the two parts). I verified the gate by probing an existing Draft ticket with 0 parts (RD-1011 "Card terminal will not pair"): clicking "Mark Ready" was refused with the inline alert, verbatim: **"Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"** (status stayed Draft; nothing on that ticket was modified). So what was required was simply having at least one part on the ticket — no other precondition was observed.

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE.** Both parts were deleted (each via an in-page confirmation reading verbatim: `Delete the part "fwrd63-n1 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.` and the same for Part B). The parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." Archiving required no confirmation dialog — the action applied immediately and the button became "Unarchive ticket". Final state: RD-1015 shows status **Ready** with an **Archived** badge; in the tickets list with "Show archived" ticked it appears as `RD-1015 | fwrd63-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Test Co | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-16`, and with "Show archived" unticked it is absent from the active list (searching "fwrd63" in the active list returns "No tickets match the current filters."). Nothing created by this run remains active.
